name: sitebyzeb
description: sitebyzeb.com — Zeb Goriely's personal site, rebuilt from the previous site

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:push
scripts.deploy:push: cd dist && git init -q -b gh-pages && git add -A && git -c user.name='Zeb Goriely' -c user.email='filmbyzeb@gmail.com' commit -qm 'Deploy sitebyzeb.com' && git -c credential.helper='!/opt/homebrew/bin/gh auth git-credential' push -qf https://github.com/codebyzeb/sitebyzeb.git gh-pages:gh-pages
